name: property-cost-estimator
description: Scrape Islamabad property listings and estimate the true cost of building a house on a plot.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix scraper install
scripts.scrape:zameen: npm --prefix scraper run scrape -- --source zameen --city Islamabad
scripts.scrape:graana: npm --prefix scraper run scrape -- --source graana --city Islamabad
